title: ContactPermissionDocument
description: Server-owned answer to whether one sender may message this person, stored at users/{uid}/contactPermissions/{senderKey}: senderKey is catch or organizer_{organizerId}. grants holds one explicit answer per channel:purpose, each bound to the receipt in contactPermissionReceipts that proves it and, for an opt-in, to the phone number it was given for. granted lists the keys that are effective now. No document, or no key, means no consent. Every consent decision rewrites it in the transaction that records the decision's receipt (issue #2460).
x-owner: messaging contact permission writer (functions/src/messaging/contactPermissions.ts), called by every consent writer

senderId.description: catch for Catch itself, otherwise the organizer id. Organiser audiences query the contactPermissions collection group by senderId and granted.

grants.description: One explicit answer per channel:purpose. An opted-in answer the send gate does not honour yet (for example a form opt-in awaiting provider review, or one with no known phone number) stays here but is left out of granted.

granted.description: The grants keys that are effective now, sorted.

endpointE164.description: The phone number an opt-in covers; it covers no other number. Null on a withdrawal, which covers every number, and on an older opt-in recorded without a number, which is never effective.

receiptId.description: The contactPermissionReceipts document that proves this answer. Only an older withdrawal can lack one.
